notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least four Elves.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Elvish Archdruid with haste.
Activate the Elvish Archdruid token by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
